g1_1_business.what_it_does: Voltamp Transformers Limited is a leading manufacturer of transformers in India, specializing in industrial and dry-type transformers. The company has a strong focus on high-margin products and operates with a debt-free balance sheet, ensuring financial stability and operational excellence. It is positioned to benefit from the growing demand for electrical infrastructure in India, driven by renewable energy integration and industrial electrification.

customers.description: 95% of listed Indian corporates and multinational companies.

competitive_advantage: Strong market share in the dry-type transformer segment (35-40%).
Debt-free balance sheet allowing for conservative capital allocation.
Established relationships with major corporate clients.
Ability to adapt to market changes with a conservative bidding strategy.

drivers.title: Jarod Greenfield Expansion
drivers.fact: The company is investing ₹200 crore in a new state-of-the-art facility at Jarod, Vadodara.
drivers.why_it_matters: This expansion will increase production capacity and enable the manufacture of higher voltage transformers, positioning the company for future growth.
drivers.evidence_quote: Capacity Addition: 6,000 MVA per annum in the first phase, bringing total capacity to 20,000 MVA.
